title: continuum-agent values
description: Unknown keys are rejected on purpose: a misspelt setting such as access.teir would otherwise be ignored silently, and the tier would fall back to the widest default.

resolveApiEndpoint.description: Read the 'kubernetes' Service's Endpoints in 'default' to report the API server's real backend address instead of the virtual ClusterIP. On by default.

mode.description: cluster: one ClusterRole, cluster-wide read access (default). namespaced: a Role per namespace in scope.namespaces instead, for tier 2.

key.description: server.caPin and enrollment.token, joined as '<caPin>.<token>'; what the install command prints instead of the two flags separately.

image.description: Removed: the probe runs the top-level image (with the argument `probe`). Accepted and ignored so an older install command does not fail.
Removed: the collector runs the top-level image (with the argument `flow`). Accepted and ignored so an older install command does not fail.
